import json,urllib.request
u='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats'
d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=8).read().decode())
rows=d.get('managedChats',d.get('rows',d if isinstance(d,list) else []))
out=[]
for x in rows:
  out.append({k:x.get(k) for k in ['id','managedChatId','url','managedChatUrl','projectId','profileId','title','enabled','mode']})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))

note: Read-only current supervisor managed-chat registry after profile reset
